definitions.explanation: A race where participants run a set distance on foot, typically a short dash. Most commonly refers to the running events at school sports days in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{徒競走|ときょうそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧になった。
examples.english: I came first in the footrace at the sports day.

examples.japanese: {徒競走|ときょうそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧です。

⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{徒競走|ときょうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だった。
examples.english: I looked forward to running in the footrace at the elementary school sports day.

notes:
FORMS:
{徒|と} (on foot) + ⟦{競走|きょうそう}→競走：15644_kyousou⟧ (race). Literally 'a race on foot.'

CULTURAL NOTE:
A staple event at Japanese school ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧ (sports days). Students typically run short distances (50m–100m depending on age). It is one of the most memorable events of school life for many Japanese people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{徒競走|ときょうそう} (sports day footrace)
- {徒競走|ときょうそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to run in a footrace)
- {徒競走|ときょうそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧ (first place in a footrace)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{競走|きょうそう}→競走：15644_kyousou⟧: race — broader term that includes any kind of racing
- かけっこ: running race — informal, childish word for the same thing
